intro.title: Regular Expressions
intro.body: In this lesson, you'll build a simple email validator that checks if user input matches a valid email format. You'll learn how to create and use regular expressions (regex) to search for patterns in text. The main technologies involved are JavaScript's RegExp object and string methods like test() and match(). You'll practice writing regex patterns with special characters to define rules for valid email addresses. By the end, you'll understand how regex can help validate different types of text input in real applications.
intro.usecase: Regular expressions are essential for validating and processing user input in real-world web applications. For example, they are used in sign-up forms to ensure email addresses and phone numbers follow correct formats, in search bars to implement advanced filtering on dashboards, and in content editors to find and replace text patterns. As a developer, you'll use regex to sanitize data, parse log files, and enforce input rules across interactive UI components like modals, settings panels, and data tables.
